components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #070707; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 15px/22px "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2A2A2A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Send
components.css: .ds-btn-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #070707; } .ds-btn-send:disabled { background: #D4D4D4; } .ds-btn-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #151515; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; font: 500 15px/22px "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #EEEEEE; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A labelled field in the More drawer.
components.css: .ds-input-field { background: #FAFAFA; color: #151515; border: 1px solid #D4D4D4; border-radius: 10px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; width: 100%; font: 400 15px/22px "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #6E6E6E; opacity: 1; } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The pill at the bottom of the column.
components.html: <input class="ds-composer" placeholder="Describe the event: place, people, date, time" />
components.css: .ds-composer { background: #FAFAFA; color: #151515; border: 1px solid #E2E2E2; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.06); font: 400 15px/22px "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-composer::placeholder { color: #6E6E6E; opacity: 1; } .ds-composer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #EEEEEE; color: #444444; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 12px/16px "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Offer row
components.css: .ds-offer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #FAFAFA; color: #151515; border: 1px solid #E2E2E2; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 17px/24px "Instrument Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-offer:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.04); } .ds-offer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-offer-price { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; }

narrative.overview:
The bench is a chat column. A person writes one line. The reply sits in a cool grey bubble, and the venues sit inside that bubble as lighter cards. The composer stays on the bottom edge. More arrives from the right. A venue's detail covers the column and then returns to the same place in the thread.

The material is cool grey, hairlines, and one sans. Coral is identity, used twice at most: the brand mark, and one dot on the best valid offer.
keyCharacteristics: One composer, floating above the bottom edge.
Offer cards live inside the assistant reply.
Instrument Sans for every role, including prices.
Black for the primary action. Coral is never a fill.

rules.name: The Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral appears on the brand mark and on at most one Best match dot. Status, including Expired, is a neutral chip: icon plus word.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Instrument Sans is the only face. Placeholder text uses {colors.placeholder} (#6E6E6E), not #8A8A8A.

rules.name: The Sticky Composer Rule
rules.body: The input remains in place. Results, More, and detail come and go around it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A shadow is for the composer, the drawer, the detail sheet, or a hovered row. It is not a default card treatment.

dos: Do keep the composer on screen and the current action reachable.
Do put Best match on the best non-expired offer, and Expired on a neutral chip.
Do render breakdown lines from the offer so they sum to the total.
Do use canvas, rail, assistant, card, ink, and coral as they are tokenised above.
donts: Don't use cream, a serif, or a <details> element for More.
Don't hard-code Best match, or put it on an expired offer.
Don't invent photos, ratings, amenities, or prices that do not sum.
Don't use coral as a fill, a wash, or error text.
